macros.name: pgfgouseblack
macros.doc: Locally applies the stone options defined by player name to the black player.

macros.name: pgfgousegoban
macros.doc: Locally applies the options of the goban defined by goban name.

macros.name: pgfgouseneutral

macros.name: pgfgouseplayers
macros.doc: Locally applies the stone options defined by neutral player name, black player name, and white player name to the corresponding players.

macros.name: pgfgousewhite
macros.doc: Locally applies the stone options defined by player name to the white player.
